source_title: What Does Etsy Withhold And Remit To Mexican Tax Authorities
source_date_if_available: Content references effective date January 1, 2026. URL returned 403; content verified via search engine index snippet, including Google Search result viewed April 14, 2026.
snippet_primary: "Starting January 1, 2026, Etsy will start collecting and remitting the revised Income tax withholding (ISR) rate for Individual sellers, which is increasing from 1% to 2.5%, on your sales on Etsy platform. There will be no changes to the 20% ISR rate or the IVA rate applied in cases where no RFC ID is provided or the RFC ID provided is invalid. For legal entity sellers, Etsy will also start withholding 2.5% Income tax (ISR) and 8% VAT (IVA), on sales on the Etsy platform, provided a valid RFC ID is provided."
subject_exact: Etsy revised ISR and IVA withholding rates for Mexico individual and legal entity sellers effective January 1, 2026
metric_unit: percent (ISR for individual sellers with valid RFC)
local_qualifiers: provided a valid RFC ID is provided
parser_notes: Multiple rates stated: 2.5% ISR (individual, valid RFC), 20% ISR (no RFC), 2.5% ISR + 8% IVA (legal entity, valid RFC). Primary metric_value_raw captures individual ISR rate.
